block.neighbor_contract: previous_block_id and next_block_id only within one document_version and reading-order parent

representations.payload_metadata: identity, provenance, security and filter fields
representations.retrieval_text: document title + heading breadcrumb + exact child content

identity_contract.hash: sha256 of UTF-8 canonical JSON with sorted keys and compact separators
invariants: same source bytes plus same parser version plus same chunker version yields the same document version, block IDs and chunk IDs
a source-byte change yields a new document_version
a parser or chunker change yields a distinct derived representation and index_id
unchanged re-ingestion is idempotent and creates no duplicate logical chunks
all ID inputs are canonical fields; random UUIDs are forbidden

candidate_b.name: structural_safe_children
markdown_pipeline: parse Markdown with markdown-it-py 4.2.0 and source maps
construct heading section tree and ordered atomic blocks
preserve paragraphs, list groups, fenced code, tables, blockquotes, HTML blocks and headings
pack only adjacent compatible blocks within the same structural parent
recursively subdivide only an oversized legal block
serialize document title plus heading breadcrumb plus exact child content
measure the complete serialized retrieval text with the actual embedding tokenizer
reject or record CHUNK_OVERFLOW before embedding if the complete serialization exceeds the hard maximum

target_token_policy.reason: 5A0 has no evidence for a magic soft chunk size

overlap_policy.forced_prose_subdivision: at most one deterministic boundary sentence or paragraph, with duplicated source spans recorded

oversize_policy.prose: paragraph then sentence then tokenizer-offset fallback
oversize_policy.list: retain list identity; split by complete items and repeat required list marker/context
oversize_policy.code: preserve complete fenced block when it fits; split only at deterministic line boundaries while repeating fence/language context
oversize_policy.table: preserve complete table when it fits; otherwise header-propagating row groups
oversize_policy.smallest_legal_unit_overflow: durable CHUNK_OVERFLOW; never truncate or silently drop

candidate_b.size_sweep_policy: add at most one pre-registered structural packing ablation only after a measured boundary failure; do not tune on aggregate score

candidate_c.name: candidate_b_plus_deterministic_context_expansion
candidate_c.retrieval_children_and_ranks: bit-identical to selected Candidate B child index and rank manifests
candidate_c.parent_definition: nearest parser-derived heading section within the same document_version
expansion_rules: retain every seed child and its rank
prefer the complete structural parent when it fits the declared evidence budget
otherwise add only the immediate previous and next complete siblings within the same parent
never cross document_version, structural parent, tenant or ACL boundary
deduplicate by chunk_id and exact source span
candidate_c.expansion_ceiling: one complete parent or the seed plus at most one immediate sibling on each side
ordering: within one expanded unit source reading order ascending

token_budget.primary_experiment: for each query and consumer, exactly match the actual-tokenizer token count of Candidate A's exposed evidence pack at the same K
token_budget.overflow_behavior: stop before the next whole unit and record PACK_BUDGET_EXHAUSTED

candidate_c.provenance: every packed character remains mapped to exact canonical source spans and seed chunk ranks

metadata_filter_contract.phase5_implementation: schema compatibility only; tenant and ACL isolation are not implemented in Phase 5

conditional_triggers.cross_encoder_reranker: only when gold evidence is reliably present in candidate top-N but final top-K ranking remains inadequate
conditional_triggers.bm25_redesign: only after frozen lexical fixtures and v2 or later cases isolate tokenization as causal
conditional_triggers.query_transformation: only after failures demonstrate vocabulary mismatch, underspecification or multi-part retrieval need; raw-query baseline remains mandatory
conditional_triggers.semantic_chunking: only after a frozen offline structured-versus-semantic prose ablation demonstrates a specific gain without critical regressions
conditional_triggers.embedding_model_change: separate frozen experiment after Candidate B/C; never simultaneous with parser/chunker changes
conditional_triggers.hnsw_tuning: only at scale and always compared with exact-search recall

required: deterministic two-run manifest and rank fingerprints
aggregate plus per-query dense, BM25 and hybrid metrics
retrieved, drafter-exposed and verifier-exposed evidence metrics
bounded latency and storage deltas against measured Candidate A
immutable versioned index plus tested rollback target
promotion_contract.rollback: retain prior immutable index_id and switch only by an independently authorized alias/config change after qualification

phase_plan.5A1: shadow Markdown parser, provenance, deterministic IDs and structural child manifests; no serving cutover
phase_plan.5A2: immutable shadow dense/BM25 indexes and A/B measurement
phase_plan.5B: Candidate C parent/neighbor expansion and evidence packer
phase_plan.5C: only measured optimizations: BM25 hygiene, reranker, generated context, query transformation or embedding model
phase_plan.5D: one fixture-qualified heterogeneous format at a time: PDF/tables/OCR/code/books
phase_plan.5E: expanded independently adjudicated gold, genuine ABSENT slice, hidden holdout and shadow qualification

final_qualification_gaps: production or pilot failures admitted through adjudication
scale, latency, storage and recovery qualification
